name: Storybook Illustration (Drawing and Illustration; provenance explicit).
visualIdentity: Explicitly calls for recognizable characters, narrative environments, small props, and warm colors. Optional paper texture and drawn edges are allowed. Emphasis falls on observation, reactions, and emotional change, with time to read each scene. Character continuity and meaningful character actions are required.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to picture-book narratives. Combination guidance lists children's stories and brand fables as best-fit hybrids. Other uses are unspecified, and the source does not name a fixed audience or objective.
limitations: No standalone limitations are stated for the base style. Hybrids must avoid excess separation, exposed edges, and fast camera moves. Rough.js does not supply paper texture, painted materials, or character poses. Hachure fills do not imitate pencil, ink-wash, or print media.
palette: Suggested, not supplied: background #F6E9CE, foreground #493E32, accent_1 #BA7254, accent_2 #6F8871, accent_3 #D5AB55, for warm paper, earth, and soft greenery. Foreground on background measures 8.653:1. Accent_1 and accent_2 are decorative only, and accent_3 with foreground reaches 4.848:1. Task or reference colors override these values, and gradients are disabled.
motionAndInteraction: The source gives no explicit motion recipe for this style beyond reaction and observation emphasis. Implementation implies pose swaps, local path movement, and measured camera moves across narrative layers. Interactive behavior is unspecified, so video must derive all state from composition time. Motion references are optional and apply only when the scene supports them.
audio: Explicit audio direction for this style is unspecified. Suggestions must be topic-based and not assign a genre, tempo, or mandatory layer. Speech must stay intelligible without competing vocals, and audio must be checked against picture sync. Sound accents for key actions or reading holds are inferred options only.
assetRequirements: Character and background assets should be prepared as consistent narrative layers. Layered PNGs need preserved transparency, consistent dimensions, and clear naming, or numbered frame sequences with a layer manifest. Overscan beyond the crop is advised when hybridized. No fonts, audio, or source artwork are supplied, so those are unspecified.
combinations: Storybook works alone for picture books. Option one adds style-101 parallax for environment depth, sharing the palette and paper texture with consistent occlusion. Option two adds style-091 rigged characters for reusable poses and expressions, keeping drawn edges and hidden joints. Both hybrids avoid rubbery stretch and visible seams.
productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the primary renderer for brushes, textures, and bitmaps at deterministic frame times. PixiJS is optional for large sprite sets, and Rough.js is optional only for seeded sketch contours. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, timing, audio sync, and export, with Remotion as fallback only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Build representative frames first, then inspect opening, key, transition, and closing frames.
